Inspection of the front end shows a crushed radiator support, cracked bumper cover, and a bent hood latch, all
consistent with a frontal strike at low speed. The damage pattern lines up with the reported impact, and no older
damage or prior repairs are evident on the panels or underlying structure. The proposed plan calls for replacing the
bumper cover, hood latch, and radiator support, with painting and refinishing of the adjoining panels. The labor hours
requested fit the scope of this work, and the invoices reviewed show no duplicated line items. Recommend approval

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
